title: Chapter 418
text:
Buzz!

At this time, a virtual image appeared in the middle of the hall. It was a lizard-like being in luxurious clothes. He scanned the hall and looked at Han Xiao with a confused tone.

"Our organization's spaceship has been hacked. Black Star, did you do this?"

"Your reaction is too slow. I've been waiting for you." Han Xiao leaned back on the sofa and stared at the lizard-like being. He temporarily put the matter of Sylvia aside.

This spaceship belonged to an Interstellar Travel Agency, and the lowest level of authority was in the hands of the organization. Once the spaceship was taken away by an outsider, the organization would immediately notice and be able to locate the spaceship remotely unless the connection was cut off. However, doing so would not only require hacking skills but also various interference and hacking hardware to be able to block the lowest level of authority. Han Xiao had taken the captain's authority, and he had long known that the actual owner of the spaceship would come looking for him.

Although the spaceship was under his control, there was no way to block the owner's remote surveillance. With his skills, it would take him a few days to half a month to change the basic settings of the spaceship and remove the control of the lowest level of authority. The protection of the lowest level of authority was even tighter, and the difference in difficulty was like the difference between hacking into a small or medium-sized enterprise and hacking into a government office.

The lizard-like being originally thought that the spaceship had been stolen, but looking at the situation, it seemed that there was more to it. He suppressed his anger and asked for the reason.

Han Xiao explained the entire process in a concise manner. It was not too much to know that the captain had committed a heinous crime. However, what Han Xiao was interested in was her strength, not her personality, beauty, and other messy things.

There were many types of enemies, such as the Germinal Organization and Dark-star, competitors who were both friends and foes, enemies that were created by misunderstandings, and so on. In his opinion, Sylvia was an enemy that was created by misunderstandings, and Han Xiao knew what kind of misunderstandings it was.

Langley himself was a traitor, but as a father, he would definitely hide something from his daughter, or even lie to her. He would definitely find excuses for his actions. Therefore, Sylvia thought that her father's actions were against the tyrannical ruler and that he was the pioneer of liberating the people.

According to his experience in his previous life, Sylvia was still considered an upright person. She was just blinded by hatred and lies, and her mind was twisted. If she knew what kind of person her father was, she might give up on revenge like in his previous life. However, Han Xiao already knew the truth, and he knew how to quickly change Sylvia's perception. To him, it was a piece of cake … But that was not the key.

The key was, what benefits could he gain?

'Hmm … I might trigger a related mission with a reward. Then, she still has some value. So be it. I'll let her live for now and complete the mission. Then, I'll deal with her according to the situation. If she's still hostile … I'll bury her on the spot.'

Han Xiao thought.

As for letting her go? That was not possible at all.

From the perspective of a businessman, Sylvia was not only a person but also a valuable resource. He was not rich enough to waste money and resources on the street.

With that in mind, Han Xiao stood up and said, "Pack up and prepare to leave. Lock her up."

Sylvia's little face was full of shock. She looked up and asked, "Where are you taking me?"

Han Xiao said calmly.

"To see your father."

Sylvia's eyes widened in disbelief.
